metadata.title: Nano Banana Pro — Images Grounded in Facts, Up to 4K | Oddbeam
metadata.description: Nano Banana Pro (Gemini 3 Pro Image) on Oddbeam pairs Google Search grounding with up to 14 reference images and 4K output — the accuracy-first studio for infographics, localized campaigns, and brand work. 40 credits, free on Unlimited.

hero.title: Nano Banana Pro Image Generator
hero.description: Some images have to be true, not just pretty. Nano Banana Pro is Google's Gemini 3 Pro Image: reasoning before rendering, Google Search grounding for real-time facts, up to 14 reference images with 5 consistent people, and the most legible in-image text of any model — at up to 4K. 40 credits per image, free on Unlimited.

usage.title: Design With Sources, Like a Studio
usage.description: Nano Banana Pro is built for work that gets fact-checked — the workflow:

items.title: Anchor the Brand
items.description: Upload up to 14 reference images — logos, packaging, key art, faces — and keep up to 5 people consistent across the set. The brand look is pinned at the input, not repaired in review.

items.title: Ground It in Real Facts
items.description: When the image must reflect reality — weather, sports, recipes, product specs — Nano Banana Pro draws on Google Search, so the infographic cites the world as it is today.

items.title: Let It Plan, Then Render
items.description: Built on Gemini 3's reasoning, the model plans composition, lighting, and typography before drawing — then self-corrects hands, signage, and physics in the loop before you see the frame.

items.title: Localize and Upscale
items.description: Translate the in-image text into new languages without breaking the layout, then render the winner at up to 4K — one master asset becomes a multilingual, print-ready campaign.

features.title: The Accuracy-First Studio on Oddbeam
features.description: What separates Nano Banana Pro from faster siblings:

items.title: Grounded in Google Search
items.description: Real-time information from Search feeds the render — infographics with today's facts, weather-aware creatives, product-accurate visuals. When being wrong is the expensive failure mode, this is the feature that matters.

items.title: Studio-grade control surface
items.description: Camera angle, focus, color grading, and lighting are all instructable; localized edits fix one region while the rest of the frame holds. It behaves like a design tool that takes direction.

items.title: 14 references, 5 consistent people
items.description: The largest reference surface in its class keeps characters, packaging, and brand elements stable across dozens of outputs — series campaigns stop re-casting themselves.

items.title: Typography that reads like design
items.description: Legible in-image text across multiple languages, from short taglines to long paragraphs, with varied textures and fonts — the reason posters and packaging land here instead of elsewhere.

items.title: Reasoning that self-corrects
items.description: Built on Gemini 3 Pro, each render runs a plan-generate-review loop that fixes hands, signage, and physics before delivery — fewer retries per usable image.

testimonials.title: For Work That Gets Fact-Checked

items.question: How much does Nano Banana Pro cost per image?
items.answer: Nano Banana Pro costs 40 credits per generation on Oddbeam for Pro plan users, and Unlimited plan subscribers generate it for free — yearly Unlimited drops the rate to 4 credits. It is not available on the Starter plan; the Pro plan at $89.99 per month with 10,000 credits covers about 250 images.

items.question: What is Nano Banana Pro built on?
items.answer: Nano Banana Pro is Google DeepMind's Gemini 3 Pro Image model — the accuracy-first tier of the Nano Banana family. It pairs Gemini 3's reasoning and world knowledge with image generation, including Google Search grounding for real-time facts.

items.question: How many reference images can Nano Banana Pro take?
items.answer: Up to 14 reference images per generation, with up to 5 people kept consistent across outputs — the largest reference surface in its class, built for brand kits, character series, and packaging systems.

items.question: Does Nano Banana Pro render text accurately?
items.answer: Yes — legible in-image text is its headline strength, across multiple languages from short taglines to long paragraphs. It is also the right tool for translating and localizing existing in-image copy without breaking the layout.

items.question: Can Nano Banana Pro use real-time information?
items.answer: Yes. Google Search grounding lets the model pull current facts — weather, sports results, product data — into the image. Infographics and explainers render from what is true today, not what the training data remembers.

items.question: Nano Banana Pro or Nano Banana 2 — which should I pick?
items.answer: Pick Pro when the image must be exactly right: Search-grounded facts, 14 references, studio controls, 4K, at 40 credits. Pick Nano Banana 2 when speed and multi-round conversational editing matter more, at the same 40-credit rate on Starter-eligible plans. Pro is the studio; 2 is the sketchpad.
